audience: A senior data engineer expanding into production machine learning and AI systems
languagePolicy: Publish complete Korean and English versions
selectionRules: Prefer papers published or substantially revised during the previous seven days.
Prefer concrete methodology, experiments, reusable system ideas, or released code over broad position papers.
Balance practical relevance, novelty, evidence quality, and topic diversity.
Do not repeat an arXiv paper that already appears in the public digest archive.
Skip papers whose important claims cannot be verified from the paper body or primary project materials.
